description: Configure which label and moderator are auto-applied to contacts that arrive from a Meta Click-to-WhatsApp ad. Pass 0 for either field to clear that setting. Pass nothing to leave both as they were. Run get_labels and get_moderators first to find valid IDs.

agent_id.description: Moderator (User) ID to auto-assign on ad-lead arrival. 0 clears the setting (no moderator auto-assigned).

label_id.description: ContactLabel ID to auto-apply on ad-lead arrival. 0 clears the setting (feature disabled for labels).

name: update_ad_lead_settings
